sections.content: Use ser, estar, tener and descriptive structures to explain identity, origin and belonging. Combine personal descriptions with expressions such as ser de, venir de and sentirse parte de.

items.spanish: Soy de Hungría, pero ahora vivo en Vietnam.
items.english: I am from Hungary, but now I live in Vietnam.

items.spanish: Me siento parte de esta comunidad.
items.english: I feel part of this community.

items.spanish: Mi origen forma parte de mi identidad.
items.english: My origin is part of my identity.

sections.content: Use ser de for origin, vivir en for residence and sentirse parte de to express belonging.
